headings.h1: Pie charts for share of total

intro: Show part-to-whole distribution with a reusable pie or donut wrapper. PieChart composes Recharts `Pie` and `Cell` primitives with the same Zentauri frame variants used across the chart system.
useCases: Ticket volume split across support channels.

faqs.question: Can I render a donut chart instead of a full pie?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set `innerRadius` to a percentage or number to open the center; keep it at `0` or omit it for a full pie.

faqs.question: How do I control slice colors?
faqs.answer: Add a `color` field to each datum or rely on the shared chart palette fallback order when `color` is omitted.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Renders proportional slices with shared tooltip and legend wiring.

Use the same appearance and density tokens as the other Zentauri charts.

sections.heading: Data shape
sections.body: Each row should include a label field and a numeric value field. Pass those keys through `nameKey` and `dataKey`.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body:
Keep segment labels concise and ensure color is not the only cue when comparing categories.

Prefer the legend when slice labels would crowd the chart.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Import from `@zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/charts/pie` inside client components when interaction is required.
